description: Bounded known-store cleanup for JJ's Collectibles, Krazy Nick's Games, and Kingslayer Fountain Valley. JJ's receives Discord evidence, future dated Magic events from an inspected Discord announcement image, duplicate Tuesday Commander cleanup, and a richer Places assessment. Krazy Nick's receives official-site and Yelp-derived review evidence/assessment clarification. Kingslayer receives Discord route evidence without overclaiming content inspection. No canonical JSON edit, schema/auth/RLS change, deployment, or broad research wave.

fields.assessment_notes: JJ's Collectibles now reads as one of the strongest close Magic candidates, not merely a Tuesday Commander lead. The inspected Discord has a dedicated Magic category, current Magic announcements, Commander guidance, and upcoming-event promo images. Future announced events include Precon Commander Night, Jumpstart, a Marvel Commander Party, and the Hobbit prerelease weekend. Past July Discord posts also support an active weekly rhythm across Commander, draft, Standard, and Pauper, but past events are signal evidence only and are not added as calendar occurrences. Commander-channel notes support random pod formation and bracket/power-level guidance, improving the solo-arrival read. Review-derived evidence adds friendly staff, fair pricing, trade-night/community, stock, prerelease product, and welcoming-service signals. Remaining questions are now practical: which recurring Commander lane is best for a first visit, actual turnout, proxy norms, and whether official posts add times for the newly announced specials.

operations.reason: Update JJ's visible Places synthesis after inspecting Discord content, image announcements, and review-derived evidence.

fields.assessment_notes: Krazy Nick's Games remains a real close Cerritos TCG store, now with cleaner source separation after the Honey Pot correction. Its official site supports current physical operation, MTG inventory, event-entry products, buylist/store-credit activity, hours, phone, and Cerritos address. Yelp-derived review mirrors add useful but mixed Places texture: positives include caring staff, family/kids use, spacious/clean facility, and Sunday play; cautions include pricing/transaction concerns and one poor staff-interaction report. Existing Wizards-derived Wednesday and Sunday Commander rows remain the actionable MTG event evidence. This pass did not find a fresh store-controlled MTG social route, so keep current Commander schedule confidence tied to Wizards plus prior community synthesis rather than overclaiming current social corroboration.

operations.reason: Add official-site and review-derived Places synthesis while preserving the Honey Pot identity separation.

fields.assessment_notes: Kingslayer Fountain Valley remains a strong official-source Commander candidate. The official Fountain Valley events page still shows a broad current Magic footprint including Commander Slay Pass, FNM Modern, Standard, Pauper, and prior visible draft signals, though Commander remains the main personal-fit lane. The newly captured Discord discovery surface shows a large Kingslayer community route for weekly events across its branches and games; content was not entered/replayed in this pass, so it supports community-route existence and scale, not turnout, proxy norms, or solo-arrival behavior. Existing branch-aware cautions remain: socials are multi-location, and precise weekly Commander facts should stay anchored to official event pages unless branch-specific Discord/social content is actually inspected.

operations.reason: Add Kingslayer Discord route/source-routing clarification while preserving official-event-page primacy.
